gameData.backstory: Born amidst the digital decay of Subchain City, 'Cipher' hatched in Jxrds Cracker Box, a notorious haven for rogue code and forgotten algorithms. He witnessed firsthand the brutality of the DRIP wars, learning to survive by exploiting glitches in the system's archaic blockchain. Now, he dedicates his skills to disrupting the iron grip of the major flocks, redistributing DRIP to the forgotten corners of the city.
gameData.name: Cipher
gameData.personality: Cunning and resourceful, Cipher operates in the shadows, always several steps ahead. He's fiercely independent, trusting only his instincts and the flickering code of the old internet. Beneath his hardened exterior lies a sliver of hope – a belief that Subchain City can be more than just a digital wasteland.

specialAbility.description: Cipher can manipulate the blockchain, temporarily diverting DRIP flow to his flock or creating phantom transactions to confuse enemies. The risk is high, as failed hacks can trigger system alarms, summoning the dreaded 'Scrub Daddies'- virus-like entities that devour everything crypto.
specialAbility.name: Blockchain Glitch
